meta.executed: 9/9 focused instruction-validation inputs; ClipKIT 2.14.0, trimAl 1.4.1, BMGE 1.12 and 2.0, MACSE 2.07, PAML 4.10.10 and PhyIN 1.0. Full IQ-TREE sensitivity evidence is retained in runs_v2; exact-SHA execution is runs_v8 plus overlap_validation.
meta.execution_note: Exact-commit re-audit after the current-main P2 fixes and one frontmatter schema repair. runs_v8 replays trimmer, parser, safeguard and shipped-example commands with tree bootstraps intentionally skipped; runs_v2 retains the completed synthetic tree regressions. Synthetic inputs are under data/.

scientific_integrity.detail: The skill keeps an untrimmed sensitivity route, refuses support-driven over-trimming, and directs branch-site users away from generic column trimming.

methodological_ground.detail: The sequence-overlap section makes thresholds dataset-dependent, requires a header diff, and gives a relaxation action when full-length records are lost.

code_usability.detail: The supported frontmatter validator passes. Executed commands covered ClipKIT, trimAl, both BMGE versions and their mismatch guard, MACSE, PAML cleanup, PhyIN, and all shipped examples.

functional_suitability.note: Goal routing, explicit modes and BMGE version-specific syntax are consistent.

reliability.note: Output guards, column maps, overlap header diff and threshold-relaxation guidance are present.

performance_context.note: Specialist workflows are progressively disclosed in references/.

agent_usability.note: Decision rules and the scoped 20%/40% interpretation are clear; downstream tree comparison still requires external tooling.

human_usability.note: Task-oriented usage guide and concrete warnings are clear.

security.note: Local inputs and list-form subprocess examples; no credential or destructive operation.

maintainability.note: Version branches and examples are testable; unavailable specialist tools remain reference-only in this Windows environment.

agent_specific.note: Supported frontmatter schema validates and references keep the primary path compact.
